content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the klaipeda district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property specifically an apartment the marriage has been dissolved and both parties have been awarded equal shares of the apartment they also have joint obligations with a creditor the court used specific articles from the civil code to determine the division of assets the applicant sought a divorce on the grounds of fault and requested the division of marital property they claimed that the defendants violence and alcohol problems made it impossible to live together the court upheld the applicants request and ordered the defendant to pay for half of the loan interest and costs the court also informed a third party about the proceedings but their participation was not necessary the court ordered the defendant to pay the stamp duty and costs of legal aid to the state
